stories.headline: Anthropic just priced its IPO at $83 a share
stories.blurb: The Claude maker is going public with 980 million shares at $83 each, valuing the company at over $81 billion. Trading starts November 19, 2026 on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Anthropic will raise about $79 billion from the offering, with existing shareholders selling a small portion.
stories.why_it_matters: One of OpenAI's main competitors is about to become a public company with serious capital.

stories.headline: Gemini can now click around your Mac for you
stories.blurb: Google's Mac app now has computer use — it can open your files, navigate apps, and handle multi-step tasks like filling forms or building presentations. You pick which apps it can touch, and watch it work in a live preview window. Rolling out now in the US.
stories.why_it_matters: Desktop AI agents just went from demo to daily tool on the platform most developers actually use.
stories.original_headline: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

stories.headline: ChatGPT now transcribes your voice as you speak
stories.blurb: ChatGPT's new Live Dictation feature transcribes your audio in real time as you talk, instead of waiting until you finish recording. The 10-minute recording limit is gone, and you can edit the live transcript in the prompt box. Rolling out now on web, desktop, and mobile for all ChatGPT plans.
stories.why_it_matters: Voice input just became as fast as typing for getting prompts into ChatGPT.
stories.original_headline: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation

stories.headline: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, a fast agent that scores #2 on Vals
stories.blurb: Neon ranks #3 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index and #2 on the Vals Index, with a 1-million-token context window. It's priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. Rolling out today in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and to Pro/Ultra subscribers.
stories.why_it_matters: Google's latest model prioritizes speed and steerability over pure capability — a shift toward deployable agents.

stories.headline: OpenAI built an AI agent that debugs ChatGPT performance while engineers sleep
stories.blurb: OpenAI's Performance Factory uses Codex agents to automatically investigate slowdowns, write fixes, and verify they worked—handling 17 investigations daily. In three months, it root-caused over 600 performance issues without human intervention. Engineers now define workflows once and let agents handle the recurring debugging work.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows agents moving from chat assistants to autonomous systems that run entire engineering workflows.
stories.original_headline: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
